systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Cryogenic Supercritical Nitrogen Shock Dehydration Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Cryogenic High-Pressure Food Dehydration Skid (ASME Section VIII Div 1 / CGA P-12 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05 & 23-06 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Pressure Continuous Cryogenic Nitrogen Infusion Vessel (35–55 bar, -150°C to -196°C) coupled with Supersonic Shock Depressurization Nozzle & Vacuum Sublimation Belt
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Cryogenic Austenitic AISI 316L (UNS S31603) with Charpy V-Notch Impact Testing at -196°C (KV > 80 J) and Vacuum Jacketed Insulated Lines (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Continuous Ambient Oxygen Depletion Monitoring (O2 < 19.5% auto-scram), ASME UV-Stamped Cryogenic Thermal Relief Valves, and Anti-Embrittlement Interlocks
systemArchitectures.description: Continuous industrial bioprocessing skid for instant shock dehydration and micro-cellular puffing of delicate probiotic foods and functional matrices. Supercritical/liquid nitrogen infuses the interstitial cell voids under high pressure; supersonic decompression flashes the dissolved gas into high-velocity micro-jets that instantly vaporize free water and lock in porous honeycomb structures without thermal degradation.

systemArchitectures.name: Sanitary Supersonic Shock Depressurization Matrix Puffer
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Thermodynamic Phase Expansion Puffer (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / 3-A Sanitary Standard 23-06)
systemArchitectures.technology: Twin-Chamber Isochoric Nitrogen Saturator with Converging-Diverging De Laval Shock Expansion Orifice & Inert Low-Pressure Receiver
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L with Monel 400 Cryogenic Needle Valves and PTFE/Kel-F Cryogenic Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Differential Expansion Pressure Transducers, Emergency Nitrogen Bleed Vents, and Acoustic Jet Silencers
systemArchitectures.description: High-volume shock expansion reactor optimized for crispy functional fruit dices, puffed berry crunchies, and aerated active botanical pieces. Delivers uniform honeycomb porosity with rapid moisture flashing to under 3.0% residual water.

systemArchitectures.name: Dual-Stage Cryogenic Infusion & Subatmospheric Sublimation Loop
systemArchitectures.classification: Advanced Two-Stage Continuous Lyophilization Engine (ASME Section VIII / USDA Organic Compliant)
systemArchitectures.technology: Stage 1 Supercritical Nitrogen Saturation followed by Stage 2 Continuous Rotary Microwave-Assisted Sublimation Vacuum Chamber (0.1–0.5 mbar)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Hastelloy C-22 Cryogenic Injection Core with Borosilicate Sight Windows and Seamless 316L Sanitary Piping
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual Rupture Discs, Laser-Guided Ice Sublimation Sensor, and Vacuum Seal Leak Detector
systemArchitectures.description: Premier continuous dehydration configuration for high-value bioactive peptides, marine collagen sponges, and sensitive pharmaceutical-grade probiotics. Achieves ultra-deep dehydration (aw < 0.16) in under 90 seconds of processing time.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Modular Pilot SND-BP Research & Validation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Pilot Lyophilization & Dehydration Simulator (ISO Class 5 Cleanroom / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Variable-Pressure Micro-Infusion Reactor (5–65 bar) with High-Speed Flash Pyrometry and Dynamic Porosimetry Sensors
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Titanium Grade 5 Cryogenic Nozzle with Electropolished AISI 316L Pressure Enclosure (Ra ≤ 0.2 µm)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Laser Vibrometry Cryo-Seal Monitor, Triple Redundant O2 Sensors, and Inert Gas Purge
systemArchitectures.description: High-precision validation skid for pilot plants, biotechnology laboratories, and functional food developers formulating next-generation live probiotic snack bars, freeze-dried yogurt drops, and delicate bioactive nutrient wafers.

targetMatrices.name: Freeze-Concentrated Probiotic Fruit Puree Cubes (Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG)
targetMatrices.description: Concentrated berry and yogurt puree infused with live probiotic cultures. Supercritical nitrogen flashes intra-cellular moisture into vapor micro-voids, maintaining cell wall integrity and avoiding ice crystal shearing to deliver 98.5% live bacterial survival.

targetMatrices.name: Whole Wild Nordic Lingonberries & Bilberries (Anthocyanin Rich)
targetMatrices.description: Delicate, thin-skinned wild berries vulnerable to thermal shriveling and weeping. SND-BP expands the berries without skin rupture, preserving 99.4% monomeric anthocyanins and creating a delicate, airy crispy texture that dissolves instantly on the tongue.

targetMatrices.name: Marine Collagen Peptide & Hyaluronic Acid Micro-Foam Matrix
targetMatrices.description: Hydrolyzed fish collagen and glycosaminoglycan slurry. High-pressure cryogenic nitrogen creates an ultra-uniform open-cell sponge structure with instant cold-water solubility and zero peptide denaturation or thermal fishy odor formation.

targetMatrices.name: Cold-Brew Specialty Arabica Coffee Extract Bioactive Micro-Beads
targetMatrices.description: High-brix cold brew extract rich in delicate fruity aldehydes and volatile floral pyrazines. Cryogenic nitrogen shock puffing prevents vacuum aroma stripping, locking 97.8% of volatile aroma compounds into micro-porous dissolvable crystalline beads.

targetMatrices.name: Spirulina Algae & Marine Chlorella Micro-Honeycomb Crisps
targetMatrices.description: Thermally fragile blue-green microalgae containing phycocyanin pigment and essential amino acids. SND-BP prevents heat-induced oxidation and unpleasant sulfurous aromas, yielding vibrant blue-green honeycomb crisps for clean-label superfood snacks.

cryogenicInjectors.name: High-Pressure Multi-Orifice Micro-Jet Cryogenic Nitrogen Infuser
cryogenicInjectors.description: Multi-port injector dispersing supercritical/liquid nitrogen directly into product flow. Micro-jets penetrate deep into cellular pores in less than 2.5 seconds, achieving 99.2% gas saturation prior to shock depressurization.

cryogenicInjectors.name: Supersonic Converging-Diverging (De Laval) Shock Depressurization Nozzle
cryogenicInjectors.description: De Laval supersonic nozzle accelerating saturated biomass from 45 bar down to 50 mbar. The sudden Mach 1.2 shock expansion shatters water surface tension and vaporizes boundary-layer moisture in milliseconds.

cryogenicInjectors.name: Dual-Fluid Annular Swirl Cryogenic Matrix Atomizer
cryogenicInjectors.description: Annular vortex mixing nozzle creating high rotational shear between cryogenic liquid nitrogen and liquid puree, producing calibrated micro-beads with immediate surface freezing and inner nitrogen dissolved saturation.

cryogenicInjectors.name: Conventional Static Freeze-Dryer Shelf (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
cryogenicInjectors.description: Slow conductive freezing plate without high-pressure cryogenic infusion or shock expansion. Large ice crystals puncture cell walls, killing over 85% of probiotic bacteria and resulting in collapsed, shriveled, rubbery matrices with 24-hour cycle times.

expansionAtmospheres.name: Continuous Multi-Stage High-Vacuum Sublimation Chamber (0.05–0.20 mbar)
expansionAtmospheres.safetyInterlocks: Continuous Roots Blower Vacuum Safety Interlocks & Condenser Ice Level Probes
expansionAtmospheres.description: Ultra-low pressure vacuum envelope maintaining water well below its triple point (6.11 mbar, 0.01°C). Drives rapid, continuous non-thermal sublimation of flash-frozen micro-crystals without liquid phase puddle formation.

expansionAtmospheres.name: Low-Pressure Inert Nitrogen Controlled Atmosphere Chamber (20–50 mbar)
expansionAtmospheres.safetyInterlocks: Inert Gas Pressure Relief & Oxygen Ingress Seal Monitoring
expansionAtmospheres.description: Inert gas-blanketed receiver operating in the transitional vacuum regime. Provides ultra-gentle moisture extraction for volatile terpenes and delicate botanical pigments with zero oxygen exposure.

expansionAtmospheres.name: Isobaric Ambient Cold Nitrogen Decompression Chamber (950–1013 mbar)
expansionAtmospheres.safetyInterlocks: High-Volume Exhaust Hood & Building Overpressure Vents
expansionAtmospheres.description: Near-atmospheric expansion suitable for coarse structural puffing. Relies on post-expansion dry air finish tunnels; lower moisture removal during the primary flash step.

expansionAtmospheres.name: Uncontrolled Ambient Air Depressurization Flashing (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
expansionAtmospheres.description: Depressurization directly into warm humid ambient air. Atmospheric water vapor condenses instantly onto sub-zero product surfaces, causing structural melting, pore collapse, microbial recontamination, and sticky unpalatable product.
